title: Sign identity for the BLR indicator
statement:
For $a,b,c\in\mathbb F_2$, let $(-1)^u$ denote the real sign associated with $u\in\mathbb F_2$. Then
\[2\mathbf 1_{\{a+b=c\}}-1=(-1)^a(-1)^b(-1)^c.\]
